authorization: The user explicitly requested repair of B06-S01/B06-S02 and regression verification. Runtime adapters and lifecycle tests changed only to implement the required storage contract.
scope: The two confirmed shared storage findings, their direct GM/Tauri renderer adapters and the workbench mount/disposal needed by the storage lifetime. This is not acceptance of all B06 candidates, native product mirroring, portable-data preflight or live runtime behavior.

changes.detail: ProductGenerationBackend requires a synchronous withExclusiveWrite guard around initial generation reads and the entire commit path. Stale checks, reclamation, staging, verification, runtime proxy writes and pointer publication share the guard. The memory test backend rejects nested writers; the final-check/publication interleaving now rejects the competing save rather than acknowledging a lost update.

The GM adapter registers a unique tab session using GM.saveTab before checking GM.getTabs. A second expanded workbench fails before product IO. Initial state uses async GM reads, and ordered acknowledged GM writes stop on failure. No synchronous GM key enumeration or cached value is used for locking. Actual unmount/pagehide freezes the writer, drains queued IO and removes only its own registration. Pending initialization, session replacement, closed tabs and late disposal have explicit owners. The Userscript root now renders a persistent storage-error toast from serializable AppErrorState; the event listener is disposed with its scope.

The renderer guard prevents synchronous reentry and compares the persisted local mirror with the expected value, rejecting stale storage instances. Startup rechecks the local mirror before/after the awaited native save. Existing native revision validation and atomic replacement are unchanged.

A shared core sanitizer retains HTTP(S) and protocol-relative artwork/page metadata URLs while dropping Blob/data/file URLs and embedded credentials. Both host library and download-history normalizers use it. Save/reload/export tests preserve stable track IDs and plugin namespaces and exercise ordinary stable URL controls.

visibleBehavior: Userscript now permits one expanded workbench session per script-manager tab inventory. Hiding retains ownership for playback/downloads; another tab receives an explicit close-the-owning-tab/retry error. Actual unmount/page exit releases after persistence. Tauri retains its main-WebView composition.

checks.detail: Storage authority remains injected. Shared generation code has no GM/Tauri/app imports; GM tab/value APIs remain in the userscript platform and required grants appear in the production artifact. No new package, persisted schema, compatibility reader or IPC alias was added.

Permanent tests cover staging/publication interleavings, stale renderer instances, same-realm replacement and late disposal, simultaneous GM initialization, missing self registration, pagehide during/after initialization, queue draining, every GM write failure before/after persistence, mount failures and idempotent unmount. Existing generation failure/reclamation/import tests remain passing.

Blob URL regression is covered in both library and download snapshots with stable HTTP(S)/CDN controls. Host IDs/recipes/plugin namespaces and proxy-secret isolation remain covered; poisoned writers cannot continue persisting proxy settings. No native credentials or external-plugin authority were introduced.

Tests remain with their implementation owners. Both data-ownership and runtime-development guides are synchronized in English/Chinese. Root tests/typecheck/lint/build pass; final affected GM/lifecycle cases are rerun after the last guard change. Unrelated existing documentation-format debt is recorded separately.

limitations: No browser, application, preview server, emulator or live Tampermonkey regression was launched. GM tab/value API doubles and production artifacts do not establish live script-manager cache/visibility, suspend/resume or abrupt-navigation acceptance.
Tauri tests include the renderer/native IPC double and the existing root Rust suite. Multi-process delivery and a separate full native product-mirror audit are not accepted by this fix.
Portable import/export preflight, unknown-namespace policy, other shared repositories and full B09 projection withdrawal remain independent audits.

The GM synchronous facade returns after enqueueing persistence; flush/dispose waits for acknowledgment, and failures freeze later saves and report a storage error. It does not claim that a page can finish all pending asynchronous work after forced process termination.
Full format:check retains existing failures in unrelated maintained documents; changed files are checked separately. There is no overall repository or B06 acceptance claim.

officialReferences.use: Manager-owned getTab/saveTab/getTabs registration and tab lifetime; using these APIs does not replace live acceptance.
The published implementation demonstrates why synchronous GM values/key enumeration cannot be treated as atomic cross-tab lock registers.
Official upstream injection-cache issue motivated removal of synchronous cache dependence from the product adapter.
